prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE replacement jump-obstacle sprite for an existing minimalist pixel-art horse racing game.
Input image is the actual existing brown horse, 26x18 native pixels enlarged 8x. Match its small flat pixel clusters and restrained shading; it is a scale/style reference, do not include a horse.
Subject: a lightweight rustic equestrian jump hurdle in a readable SIDE-ON 2D game view, 28 native pixels wide and 18 native pixels high. Exactly two slender dark walnut timber uprights, each only 2 native pixels thick, with tiny flat stabilizing feet 4 pixels wide and 1 pixel tall. A SINGLE slim straight ivory horizontal pole, 2 pixels thick, crosses the upper third between the uprights, with exactly two small muted terracotta-red bands on the pole. A dark brown 1-pixel lower edge on the pole makes it legible against tan dirt. Thin angled support on one outer side is optional, at most 1 pixel thick. Narrow dark posts give the obstacle a light open silhouette, not a solid block. The pole is visibly easy for a tiny horse to jump over.
Composition: the single complete isolated sprite centered on a square fully transparent canvas, generous empty alpha margins. No environment, no terrain, no other items, no shadows, no labels, no grid.
Style: native source canvas just 64x64 pixels enlarged by integer nearest neighbor; make each native pixel a deliberate large square. No thick outlines around entire object. Maximum 6 opaque colors: dark walnut #55402F, wood #8B643E, tiny warm top highlight #BD965A, pole cream #F2E2BE, muted terracotta #A75740, pole underside #80694B. Flat exact color areas. No grain, no texture, no gradients, no glow, no soft lighting, no 3D, no bevels, no antialiasing.
Important design restrictions: no wide pedestal bases, no chunky golden columns, no gym bench appearance, no bulky feet, no ornamental details, no broad white panels, no second rail. This should feel like a modest handmade course obstacle that belongs with the tiny original pixel horse. True transparent PNG.
layoutChanges: Removed the hay bale, bench, flowers, rock pile, arrow sign and bush along the bottom edge.
Replaced all four hurdle visuals; kept original lane spacing and 0.65 clearance.
